description: The ToughSystem 2.0 DS400 Toolbox comes with patented auto-connect side latches for easy one-hand operation. Its 2-piece metal wire front latches add durability when securing tools inside. It is IP65 rated for dust and water resistance and has a 50 Kg load capacity. The toolbox has a removable inner tray for optimal organization. The ToughSystem 2.0 Toolbox is compatible with all ToughSystem products. High performance step-shank design for optimal penetration. High performance seal in the lid ensures they are dust tight and water jet resistant (IP65) to withstand the most severe weather. NEW AUTO STACKING LATCHES - Intuitive, Easy To Use And Time Saving Latches For Connecting Modules Together. NEW HALF MODULE COMPATIBILITY- Allowing Half Width Modules To Be Connected To The Box. NEW EASYCLOSE METAL WIRE FRONT LATCHES - Providing Easy One Handed Operation. NEW WIDER & STRONGER HANDLES - Better Ergonomics and Stronger. NEW DEWALT TRACKER READY - Internal fixing point allows DEWALT Tracker to be installed and box tracked via DEWALT Tool Connect. NEW METAL REINFORCED PADLOCK EYE - Providing Superior Security To The Contents.
